summary: Frontend-only retest of the reordered post-recording flow (PII 'Confidentiality Check' gate now shown at status='analyzing'). Scenarios A, B, C, D all executed end-to-end via Playwright with cookie-injected auth (MFA bypassed via get_tokens.py). RESULT: A PASS, B PASS, C PASS, D PASS-with-one-pre-existing-UI-bug. The reorder change itself is working correctly in every tested path; the only defect found is a stale-state bug in markReviewed() that falsely blocks sign-off until a manual page refresh (pre-existing, unrelated to the reorder).

minor.issue: pii_redactions is double-JSON-encoded in Postgres (jsonb_typeof = 'string' instead of 'array') because json.dumps() is passed to an asyncpg jsonb param that re-encodes. VERIFIED that all frontend read paths still render redactions correctly (defensive double-decode), so no user-visible impact today — but it is fragile and should be fixed by passing the list directly (or removing the manual json.dumps) in review.py ~line 1288.

IP-wide rate limit is 20 logins/15 min (login_attempts table). Automated test runs trip this quickly and get a 429 that blocks all further test logins. Not a product bug, but noted for test infra — added /app/backend/tests/clear_rate_limit.py to clear it.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking 'Mark Reviewed' the handler only patches meeting.status locally (setMeeting({...m, status: data.status})) and never refetches the meeting. meeting.attendees[].reviewed stays stale, so the sign-off confirm modal shows a FALSE warning ('1 attendee has not reviewed: Demo Manager') and signoff-confirm-btn stays DISABLED even though the DB shows both attendees reviewed and status='reviewed'. The manager must hard-refresh the page before sign-off becomes possible. Fix: await fetchMeeting() after a successful mark-reviewed call (or merge the updated attendees returned by the API).

issues: No data-testid="unified-processing-screen" element exists anywhere in MeetingReport.js — only data-testid="processing-indicator". If the review request/spec expects that testid, add it; otherwise update the spec. Not a functional defect.

action_items: HIGH: In MeetingReport.js markReviewed(), refetch the meeting (await fetchMeeting()) after the mark-reviewed POST so attendees[].reviewed is fresh — otherwise sign-off is falsely blocked until a manual refresh.

LOW: Fix the double-JSON-encoding of pii_redactions in /app/backend/routers/review.py complete_pii_review (pass the list, not json.dumps(list), to the ::jsonb param). Reads are defensively handled today so this is not user-visible.
LOW: Decide whether data-testid="unified-processing-screen" should exist on the 3-step processing screen (currently only processing-indicator).
critical_code_review_comments: markReviewed() performs an optimistic local status patch but never reconciles the rest of the server state (attendees). Any UI gated on attendees (sign-off modal) will read stale data. Prefer refetch-after-mutate for anything that gates a downstream action.

shouldShowPIIGate (MeetingReport.js ~line 530) is correctly guarded: !piiGateDone && pii_review_status !== 'reviewed' && role in (manager, admin) && transcript present && status not in (recording, processing, transcribing, processing_failed). Verified all four branches behave as intended.
complete-pii-review sets pii_review_status='reviewed' for BOTH apply and skip, so the gate correctly does not reappear on reload after a Skip — verified.

rca_of_the_issue: Sign-off block RCA: MeetingReport.js markReviewed() does `setMeeting(m => ({...m, status: data.status}))` only. The sign-off confirm modal computes `unreviewed = (meeting?.attendees || []).filter(a => !a.reviewed)` from the same client state, which was never refreshed after the POST, so the just-reviewed attendee still reads reviewed=false. Backend /api/review/{id}/mark-reviewed did persist correctly (verified in Postgres: both attendees reviewed=true, status='reviewed'). Reproduction: as manager on an in_review meeting where all other attendees have reviewed, click mark-reviewed-btn then sign-off-btn -> false 'X attendee has not reviewed' warning + disabled signoff-confirm-btn. Mitigation: refetch the meeting after mark-reviewed (or return the updated attendees array from the endpoint and merge it).
